name: FEDLIC TOKYO
author: FEDLIC TOKYO
tagline: an ambient drone synth: slow FM swells and deep sub fields, steered by knobs
description: GWAAN-1 turns the FM-1 into an ambient drone machine. Four layers - a gliding FM voice (mihyon), a sub drone with crossfading chord fields (guwaan), filtered-noise air with rare drops, and beacon pings pitched from the field - play themselves from power-on. Five scenes (DEEP, FOREST, RAIN, STARS, DAWN); knob macros for glide, depth, space and drift, plus a resonant SELECT filter. Live edition: mixer page (layer volumes + mutes), an arpeggiator, FREEZE / SHIMMER / CRUSH / reverse echo, a filter LFO, four snapshots, a dice re-roll, stereo width, stage-bright lights, USB MIDI + CC. Never harsh.
credits: Built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal, MPL-2.0) and felucca-bsp.
